choices.reason: The paper's primary planned comparisons use calibrated human-rated creativity, favoring the Welch contrasts over raw-score, adjusted, and robustness variants. Among the AI arms sharing C4, C3 provides access throughout all three stages without the warning and is closest to free use of a general chatbot.

choices.reason: The paper lists C1-C2, C3-C1, C5-C1 and C3-C5 together as primary planned Welch contrasts; preferring that specification over the adjusted warning model does not select a unique contrast. These comparisons pool tasks within one session and report team-level statistics, and neither the shared-control rule nor the factorial-baseline rule uniquely orders their different AI timing and warning contrasts, so no rule resolves the tie.
